items.title: ETFs Are Net Sellers of T-Mobile (TMUS) on Nov. 3
items.summary: ETFs sold $24.5 million in T-Mobile US stock on Tuesday, with 32 funds buying and 9 selling.

items.title: Own This Many Shares of Coca-Cola, and the Dividends Could Cover Your Phone Bill
items.summary: Coca-Cola's dividend is as dependable as they come and may be able to pay some bills for investors.

items.title: Deutsche Telekom lifts 2026 targets in Q3, buyback below forecasts
items.summary: Investing.com -- Deutsche Telekom nudged up its 2026 profit and cash flow targets on Thursday after T-Mobile U.S. drove a third-quarter earnings beat, but a planned 2027 share buyback of up to €2 billion came in below analyst expectations.

items.title: Amdocs Stock Has Its Worst Day in 24 Years as T-Mobile Business Is at Risk
items.summary: The telecom software provider expects annual revenue to fall as much as 18%, with its outlook allowing for a potential end to its T-Mobile agreements.

items.title: AT&T’s vulnerability to a SpaceX mobile network push
items.summary: Investing.com -- AT&T looks like the most vulnerable U.S. carrier if SpaceX turns Starlink into a full mobile network.

items.summary: SpaceX is buying terrestrial wireless hardware from Qualcomm and will build a mobile network from the ground up.
